## FURUNCLES AND CARBUNCLES
Localized purulent infections include furuncles, carbuncles and cutaneous
abscesses. Nearly all are caused by Staphylococcus aureus. A furuncle is an
inflamed nodule that usually develops as a complication of folliculitis. A
carbuncle is a more extensive lesion that extends further into the subcutaneous
tissue. Contact a wound care nurse for more information.
Incision and drainage is the mainstay of therapy for carbuncles, cutaneous
abscesses, and large furuncles.
The decision to administer antibiotics directed against S. aureus as an adjunct
to incision and drainage should be made based on the presence of systemic
inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) or in patients with markedly impaired
host defenses.
## For recurrent skin abscesses in addition to culture and antibiotic therapy
## recommended consider a decolonization regimen.
[Select here for Staphylococcus aureus Decolonization](orzid2-gmenu-abx-staphylococcus-aureus-decolonization)
## Mild infection: Purulent infection without systemic signs of infection
Recommend incision and drainage. No antibiotic indicated.
## Moderate Infection: Purulent infection with signs of systemic infection.
Recommend incision and drainage. Culture material and use results to guide
therapy.
Treat for 5 days and extend/modify treatment if not improved in this time.
## Preferred treatment:
## Inpatient

[Trimethoprim sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)
## Alternative:
[Doxycycline 100 mg po q12h ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
## If methicillin-RESISTANT Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) is suspected or proved
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h ($) [R,DI]
## Severe Infections:
Patients who have failed incision and drainage along with oral antibiotics
or those with SIRS or for infections in those with neutropenia or diminished
neutrophil function.
Recommend incision and drainage. Culture material and use results to guide
therapy.
Treat for 5 days. Reevaluate patient and extend or modify treatment if not
improved in this time.
[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
